insights.summary: FY26 consolidated revenue rose 16% to ₹3,498 Cr with EBITDA margin up to 18.1% and PAT up 51% to ₹327 Cr; Q4 was a record at ₹999 Cr with a 19.3% margin. The aerospace, defence and semiconductor (ADS) business grew 155% to ₹316 Cr of product sales and is guided to ~₹550-600 Cr in FY27, backed by a ₹4,460 Cr five-year backlog; management expects a similar growth trajectory overall and ~₹510 Cr of capex again. New orders for the core auto business were soft because international customers held back.

what_changed.text: Capex ~₹510 Cr in FY27, similar to FY26; 10 acres bought near Bengaluru airport
Energy-storage components for a North American customer (₹80-100 Cr a year)
Blisk machining order from a large aero-engine maker
Rahul Kale made CEO of the automotive division; three new independent directors

tone.label: confident
tone.quote: Looking ahead, we remain confident of sustaining a similar growth trajectory in the coming year while maintaining healthy profitability.

analyst_questions.answer: Order visibility of ~₹8,000-8,200 Cr by end of decade; non-auto may exceed 20% of the mix.
ADS build-up pushed operating cash flow to 11% of revenue from 12%; should ease as semicon raw materials are localised.
No one-off restocking; export offtake improving but order conversions 1-2 quarters away.
Customers are booking machining capacity; machine lead times of 7-9 months are the bottleneck.

red_flags.text: New auto order bookings soft in Q4 as international customers held back.
Labour availability and attrition flagged as a key execution challenge.
Free cash flow negative as capex stays ~₹500 Cr a year.
Large investment in MMRFIC, a long-gestation defence-electronics company (45-50% stake).

business_snapshot.what_they_make: Precision-forged and machined engine and chassis parts (crankshafts, connecting rods, rocker arms), xEV and tech-agnostic parts, and machined aerospace, semiconductor-equipment and defence components
business_snapshot.customers: Bajaj, TVS, Honda, Maruti, Tata Motors, Yamaha, Suzuki, Daimler, Volvo Eicher, global PV OEMs, Boeing/Airbus tier-1s, semiconductor equipment makers
business_snapshot.revenue_mix: FY26: auto ICE ~70%, tech-agnostic and xEV ~13%, non-auto ~17% (ADS ~10%); India 65%, exports and Sweden 35%
business_snapshot.demand_drivers: Domestic two-wheeler and PV growth, OEM outsourcing of crankshafts, aerospace build rates, AI-driven semiconductor equipment demand
